name: ピアノの先生
text:
緋田さんは大丈夫だね
発表曲、もう完璧にしちゃったんだ
trans:
You're good to go, Aketa-san.
You've already perfectly learned your recital piece.

name: 美琴
text: ありがとうございます
trans: Thank you very much.

name: 美琴
text: …………カンペキ
trans: ......perfect.

name: ピアノの先生
text:
２曲目に挑戦する子もいるけど
緋田さんは、どうしよっか
trans:
There are kids who will attempt to play
a second piece, but how about you, Aketa-san?

name: 美琴
text: ２曲目？
trans: A second piece?

name: 美琴
text: それって、れんだん？
trans: Will that be... a piano duet?

name: ピアノの先生
text:
そうだね
先生との連弾がいいかな
trans:
Yeah, so I think it'll be better
to practice your duet with me.

name: ピアノの先生
text: 他の子がやる曲も見てみよっか
trans:
Let's check out the songs that
other kids will play as well.

name: ピアノの先生
text:
友だち同士でやる子もいるけど
低学年の子はだいたい先生との連弾かな
trans:
Some play the duet with their friends, but
I think lower grade students tend to play
alongside their teachers.

name: 美琴
trans: ......What is this?

name: ピアノの先生
text:
ボーカル付きのポップスだね
大学生のお姉さんが弾き語りをやるの
trans:
It's a pop song with vocals.
A college lady will be doing a piano cover of it.

name: 美琴
text: そうなんだ
trans: I see.

name: ピアノの先生
text:
２曲目は難しかったらやらなくても大丈夫だからね
１曲完璧に弾けるだけでもすごいんだから
trans:
If playing two pieces seems too hard, then it's
fine to pass on the idea for now. Being able to
play one song perfectly is already amazing by itself.

name: 美琴
text:
だいじょうぶ
２曲目、やります
trans:
I'll be okay.
I'll play two pieces.

name: ピアノの先生
text:
そっか
緋田さんはすごいね
trans:
Alright.
That's impressive of you, Aketa-san.

name: ピアノの先生
text:
それじゃあ、先生と連弾で大丈夫？
お友だちとやる？
trans:
Now that's settled, are you going to play
your duet with me, or with a friend?

name: 美琴
text: 先生と
trans: I'll play with you, Teacher.

name: ピアノの先生
text: うん、わかった
trans: Okay, got that.

name: ピアノの先生
text: 何か好きな曲はある？
trans: Got any song in mind that you'd like to play?

name: 美琴
text: 好きな曲……
trans: A song that I like......

name: ピアノの先生
text:
ふふ
試しに何か聴いてみよっか
trans:
Hehe. 
How about we listen to a few tracks for now?

name: 美琴
text:
うん
おねがいします
trans:
Yep.
Please, and thank you.

name: ピアノの先生
text:
──こんな感じかな
まずは、１曲目と同じように完璧に練習すること
trans:
―And that's pretty much how it goes.
Now, you should practice playing it until
it's just as perfect as your first piece.

name: ピアノの先生
text:
合わせるのはそれからにしよっか
できそう？
trans:
Let's put off playing together until then.
You think you'll be good with that?

name: 美琴
text: ……うん
trans: ...Yep.

name: ピアノの先生
text:
じゃあ、宿題
２曲目も練習してきてね
trans:
Alright, then your homework is to practice
both of your recital pieces.

name: ピアノの先生
text:
人と合わせるならテンポが大事だから
いつも以上に意識してみよう
trans:
Keeping up with the tempo is important when
playing with other people, so make sure to pay
extra attention to that as you play.

name: 美琴
text: わかりました
trans: Understood.

name: 美琴
text: （テンポが、大事……）
trans: (The tempo is... important.)

name: 美琴
text: ちょっと、はやい
trans: It's a bit... fast.

name: 美琴
text: これ

name: 美琴
text: いつも以上に、意識すること
trans: Have to... pay more attention to this.

name: 美琴
text: テンポをおぼえて
trans: Remember the tempo...

name: 美琴
text: キープして……
trans: And keep it steady......

name: 美琴
text: ひとりで、カンペキにすること
trans: I need to perfect this, by myself.

name: 美琴
text: 先生と、合わせられるように
trans: So I can play in tune with my teacher.

name: 美琴
text: …………むずかしそう
trans: ......This seems hard.

name: 美琴
trans: But――

name: 美琴
text: 練習すれば、弾ける
trans: If I keep practicing, I'll be able to play it.

name: 美琴
text: 弾けるようにならなきゃ
trans: I need to be able to play this.
